title: Korean-Style Braised Duck with Guk
description: A rich and flavorful dish that combines the tender meat of duck with the savory flavor of Korean-inspired guk sauce.
instructions: Season the duck with salt, black pepper, and Korean chili flakes.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck until browned, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the duck from the pot and set aside.
Add the guk, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger to the pot.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Return the duck to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the duck rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the duck and serve with the braising sauce and garnish with green onions.
